spans.s: kavaca (SITI), same as Tamil tiru-kkōl̤̣gai, the metallic cover exactly fitting the image of a deity; same as kholī, kholikā.
kavalě, also called kavaleḍu, kavaligě (CITD), Telugu-Kannaḍa; a pack of written leaves; palm leaves prepared for writing accounts.
kaveluka, kāveluka (LP), tile; cf. kivelu, Marāṭhī kaul, etc. See Ep. Ind., Vol. XXXIV, pp. 144-45.
Kavirāja (IA 26), title; sometimes found also among the Musalmans.
kāval-per̤u (SII 12), name of a tax; cf. kāval-kāni, the right to guard temples.
